title: 中国哲学（三）：荀子的思想
subtitle: Chinese Philosophy III · The Thought of Xunzi

cards.example: 荀子是战国末期的重要思想家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi was an important thinker at the end of the Warring States period.
cards.breakdown: 荀：像树枝一样分叉的事物 · 子：称呼人的后缀，表示先生或有学问的人

cards.example: 荀子继承了孔子的儒家思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi inherited the Confucian thought of Confucius.
cards.breakdown: 儒：讲究礼仪和仁德的人 · 家：学派、门派的意思

cards.back: the theory that human nature is evil
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi proposed the theory that human nature is evil.
cards.breakdown: 性：人的本性 · 恶：不好的方面 · 论：理论、见解

cards.pinyin: rén zhī xìng è, qí shàn zhě wěi yě
cards.back: Human nature is evil; what is good is the result of human effort
cards.example: 这句话体现了荀子的性恶论。
cards.exampleTranslation: This sentence reflects Xunzi's theory of human evil nature.
cards.breakdown: 人：人类 · 性：本性 · 恶：本性趋向恶 · 伪：人为努力的结果

cards.pinyin: míng yú tiān rén zhī fēn
cards.back: to understand the distinction between heaven/nature and human beings
cards.example: 荀子强调要明于天人之分。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi emphasized understanding the distinction between heaven and human beings.
cards.breakdown: 明：看清楚 · 天：自然界 · 人：人类自身 · 分：区分、界限

cards.example: 自然界是有规律地运动变化的。
cards.exampleTranslation: The natural world moves and changes according to its own laws.
cards.breakdown: 自：自身 · 然：自然、应当如此 · 界：范围、边界

cards.example: 自然界有自己的运动规律。
cards.exampleTranslation: Nature has its own laws of motion.
cards.breakdown: 规：规则 · 律：法度、节律

cards.exampleTranslation: Human beings are born with reason.
cards.breakdown: 理：道理、条理 · 性：本性

cards.front: 认识自然、利用自然、改造自然
cards.pinyin: rèn shi zì rán, lì yòng zì rán, gǎi zào zì rán
cards.back: to understand nature, use nature, and transform nature
cards.example: 人类能够认识自然、利用自然、改造自然。
cards.exampleTranslation: Human beings can understand, use, and transform nature.
cards.breakdown: 认：认识 · 用：利用 · 改：改变 · 造：制造、建造

cards.front: 组织成群体，组织成社会
cards.pinyin: zǔ zhī chéng qún tǐ, zǔ zhī chéng shè huì
cards.back: to organize into groups and form society
cards.example: 人可以组织成群体，形成社会。
cards.exampleTranslation: People can organize into groups and form society.
cards.breakdown: 组：分组 · 群：众多的人 · 社：社会 · 会：聚会

cards.example: 集体力量可以战胜许多困难。
cards.exampleTranslation: Collective strength can overcome many difficulties.
cards.breakdown: 集：聚合 · 体：整体 · 力：力量

cards.front: 人力所及，人力所不能及
cards.pinyin: rén lì suǒ jí, rén lì suǒ bù néng jí
cards.back: what human power can do and what it cannot do
cards.example: 要明白什么是人力所能及的，什么是人力所不能及的。
cards.exampleTranslation: One must know what human power can do and what it cannot do.
cards.breakdown: 人：人类 · 力：力量 · 及：达到 · 能：能力
